name: agent-obsidian-mcp-monorepo
description: Host-adapter MCP candidates for Vault Steward.

scripts.smoke: node tests/smoke-vault-workspace.mjs && node tests/smoke-paper-fetch.mjs && node tests/smoke-vault-sync.mjs && node tests/smoke-papers-search.mjs
scripts.pack:all: mkdir -p dist && npm pack --workspace packages/vault-workspace-mcp --pack-destination dist && npm pack --workspace packages/paper-fetch-mcp --pack-destination dist && npm pack --workspace packages/vault-sync-mcp --pack-destination dist && npm pack --workspace packages/papers-search-mcp --pack-destination dist
